commands: RUNID=$(env | grep '^GITHUB_RUN_ID=' | cut -d= -f2); RUNATT=$(env | grep '^GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT=' | cut -d= -f2); echo "runid=${RUNID:-none}"; echo "att=${RUNATT:-none}"

D=.prflow/tmp/review/pr-1930/32810409702-1; awk 'BEGIN{n=0} /^diff --git/{n++} n>=1 && n<=10' "$D/diff.patch" | tee "$D/batch-1.patch" | grep -c '^diff --git'; awk 'BEGIN{n=0} /^diff --git/{n++} n>=11 && n<=20' "$D/diff.patch" | tee "$D/batch-2.patch" | grep -c '^diff --git'

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
rm -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled 2>/dev/null
git status --porcelain -z > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before && git hash-object .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before

echo "=== HEAD: publication removed (expect 0 each) ==="; for f in .github/workflows/devflow-implement.yml .github/workflows/devflow.yml; do echo -n "$f: "; git show 36539f55ef0f6c5e9c58b09db75b62a12f132e0b:"$f" | grep -vE '^[[:space:]]*#' | grep -c 'echo "DEVFLOW_REFRESH_SELFTEST_FAILED='; done

echo "=== HEAD: Stop-step in-body export present (expect 1 each) ==="; for f in .github/workflows/devflow-implement.yml .github/workflows/devflow.yml; do echo -n "$f: "; git show 36539f55ef0f6c5e9c58b09db75b62a12f132e0b:"$f" | grep -cF 'export DEVFLOW_REFRESH_SELFTEST_FAILED="$RUNNER_TEMP/devflow-refresh-$HANDLE.selftest-failed"'; done

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
